description: Use once to create the initial signed sanitized cross-agent task capsule from a new task state. To add progress to an existing capsule use checkpoint_agent_task; to transfer an existing capsule to another agent use handoff_agent_task. The ledger stores only hashes and transition metadata, not task text.

completed.description: Up to 20 concise completed steps already achieved.

constraints.description: Up to 20 operational constraints the next agent must preserve.

goal.description: Sanitized task goal that another agent can understand without private context.

nextAction.description: Recommended next bounded action for the receiving agent.

remaining.description: Up to 20 remaining steps the next agent may continue.

requiredCapabilities.description: Machine-readable capability labels required from a recipient agent.

verifiedFacts.description: Up to 20 sanitized facts already verified and safe to hand off.

name: create_handoff_capsule
title: Create Handoff Capsule
